text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Political leaders will visit schools today to warn children about the dangers of drugs.
- Portugal Telecom to subsidise phone charges paid by poor families.
- Portuguese police fight money laundering caused by sale of illicit drugs.
- Pedro Ferraz da Costa, head of the Portuguese industrialists' association, said he doubted that the so-called Mateus Plan would help many ailing firms to recover.

- Preparations for the Lisbon 1998 World Fair are over budget according to the latest figures. The paper quoted a government source as saying that the latest estimates showed additional costs of 25 billion escudos.
- AMC-American Multi-Cinema wants to invest $16 million in cinemas in Lisbon.
